metadata.title: Prediction Market Trading Strategies Mastery Roadmap
metadata.description: A comprehensive learning roadmap covering 15 domains from probability fundamentals through algorithmic trading systems, designed to build systematic prediction market trading competence.

sections.title: Foundations
sections.description: Core knowledge required before any trading activity. Probability theory, platform mechanics, and financial market basics.

sections.title: Core Methods
sections.description: Intermediate skills that transform foundational knowledge into actionable trading capability. Forecasting, pricing, research, and risk management.

sections.title: Advanced Strategies
sections.description: Specialized trading strategies and portfolio-level thinking. Quantitative modeling, arbitrage, portfolio construction, market making, and event-driven trading.

sections.title: Expert Integration
sections.description: System-level mastery: automated trading, behavioral psychology, and multi-strategy integration.
